w2a.purpose: Reconstruct a financed daily portfolio from the exact frozen ART-025 R1 primary trade set without changing the strategy.

recommended_protocol_candidates.portfolio_primitive: one absolute notional unit per frozen trade before normalization
recommended_protocol_candidates.funded_normalization: scale by peak simultaneous absolute unit notional so historical peak gross exposure equals 1.0; accounting normalization only, not a deployable forward sizing policy
recommended_protocol_candidates.mark_to_market: frozen adjusted open entry; intermediate adjusted closes; frozen adjusted close exit; constant shares; no interpolation
recommended_protocol_candidates.cost_path_candidate: split frozen round-trip cost 50/50 entry/exit if exact final-PnL reconciliation holds; otherwise preserve exact legacy cost semantics
recommended_protocol_candidates.primary_benchmark: matched-SPY pseudo-book using identical dates, signs, notionals and overlap schedule
recommended_protocol_candidates.inference_candidate: stationary/dependent block bootstrap with pre-frozen automatic block-length estimator and pre-frozen fallback
recommended_protocol_candidates.optional_cost_stress_candidate: 2x frozen 20/35 bps costs; no trade/sizing changes

rejected_shortcuts: naive sqrt(252) Sharpe without serial-dependence treatment
DSR with invented or incomplete trial count
dropping frozen trades due to a new overlap cap
relabeling max_additive_drawdown_opportunity as portfolio max drawdown
must_resolve_before_freeze: exact ART-025 market-adjusted sign formula for shorts
intermediate adjusted-price availability for all 34 trades
cash/collateral edge cases under peak-overlap normalization
block-bootstrap automatic selector and fallback validated on synthetic data

w2b.central_principle: IAS measures structural asymmetry; feasibility remains outside the IAS magnitude.

evidence_layer_candidate.name: Evidence Confidence Grade
evidence_layer_candidate.principle: evidence strength controls uncertainty/confidence around structural anchors rather than adding economic score points

aggregation_candidates_not_frozen.central: equal-weight mean of five 0-5 structural anchors if synthetic validation supports interval-like anchors
aggregation_candidates_not_frozen.robustness: SMAA/global weight-space analysis with ECG-driven anchor uncertainty
additional: aggregation-rule sensitivity if multiple admissible rules remain
aggregation_candidates_not_frozen.ordinal_fallback: evaluate ordinal-compatible SMAA if 0-5 anchors cannot be defended as interval-like

w2c_discovery_candidate: bounded keyset crawl with fail-closed guards
must_resolve_before_freeze: minimum evidence confidence for ranked status
W3 GO rule calibrated on synthetic archetypes
frozen W2C discovery dictionaries and semantic rules

research_conclusions: W2A should be a funded accounting reconstruction, not a portfolio optimizer.
Exact legacy trade-PnL reconciliation is the first W2A gate; risk metrics are downstream.
Serial dependence from overlapping positions makes naive annualized Sharpe unsuitable.
Borrow fees must not be invented; missing PIT borrow data remains a limitation.
IAS must be separate from EUAS and modeled as a formative structural construct.
A single spread/PIN/volume proxy is insufficient as ground truth for event-family asymmetry.
Evidence confidence should affect uncertainty, not directly reward the IAS score.
FOMC versus statistical macro, FDA advisory versus final FDA decision, and M&A announcement versus completion should be evaluated as separate IAS families.
Global ranking robustness through SMAA is preferred over dependence on one expert-selected weight vector.
W3 remains blocked until real-family scoring occurs under a frozen IAS protocol and separate feasibility gates.
next_action: Draft and adversarially review W2A and IAS protocols using only synthetic validation, then freeze both before any W2A portfolio outputs, expanded W2C counts used for scoring, or real IAS family scores are computed.
